prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE finished opaque portrait xianxia game background, approximately 9:16 (target 941 x 1672 or closest native portrait 9:16).
Primary request: Create a NEW location, "Do Kiep Phong", a lone sharp mountain summit high above a sea of clouds at night, beneath a colossal tribulation storm-cloud vortex. The attached sword-valley reference is rendering-quality reference ONLY: match its richly painterly semi-realistic premium xianxia game-background finish, convincing rock texture, atmospheric depth and portrait framing; invent a completely different location, no swords.
Composition: Huge dark spiralling storm-cloud vortex fills the upper 45% of the canvas; its eye centered at x50%, y18%. Faint diffuse purple-blue glow INSIDE the eye, atmospheric cloud illumination only, absolutely no drawn lightning or electric streaks. Spiral has immense layered cloud volume and grand threatening scale. Beneath, several layers of distant sharp mountain peaks pierce a cold moonlit sea of clouds, progressively softer with distance. No visible moon needed. Lower third: foreground summit is a flat cracked dark-stone platform atop a lone mountain peak, with a weathered circular stone ring CARVED INTO the flat surface, not an upright portal. Ring centered at x50%, y78%, rendered as a foreshortened ellipse in perspective with ample standing space inside. Show the peak's rugged edge and rocky foreground. A few broken weathered stone pillars and wind-bent pines restricted to the far edges.
Gameplay readability: Keep central column x35–65%, y45–85% relatively uncluttered, with soft distant clouds and a clear empty standing area on the stone ring. No central pillar or tree or peak obscuring this character area. Background must work without a character.
Palette and lighting: deep indigo and slate night, cold silver moonlight shaping cloud layers and rock edges, faint violet glow within the vortex. Dramatic, foreboding, grand scale, carefully readable details without losing night atmosphere. Painterly semi-realistic, detailed cinematic environment art.
Strict constraints: ONE image, full-bleed opaque background. No characters, no people, no creatures, no lightning bolts, no electric arcs, no swords, no text, no lettering, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no borders.
